description: This file implements a proxy resolver for macOS, utilizing CFNetwork APIs to determine proxy settings for URLs, including handling PAC files and synchronizing run loop events.

classes.name: SynchronizedRunLoopObserver
classes.description: A run loop observer that synchronizes CFNetwork proxy auto-configuration URL callbacks using a lock to prevent concurrent execution.

classes.name: ProxyResolverMac
classes.description: A proxy resolver implementation for macOS that uses CFNetwork to resolve proxies for URLs, including handling PAC scripts.

methods.name: GetProxyServerScheme
methods.description: Maps CFProxyType string to ProxyServer scheme enum.

methods.name: ResultCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of CFNetwork proxy auto-configuration URL execution, storing results or errors.

methods.name: SynchronizedRunLoopObserver::AddToCurrentRunLoop
methods.description: Adds the run loop observer to the current run loop in a specified mode.

methods.name: SynchronizedRunLoopObserver::RemoveFromCurrentRunLoop
methods.description: Removes the run loop observer from the current run loop in a specified mode.

methods.name: SynchronizedRunLoopObserver::RunLoopObserverCallBack
methods.description: Handles CFRunLoopActivity events, managing lock acquisition and release to synchronize callbacks.

methods.name: ProxyResolverMac::GetProxyForURL
methods.description: Determines proxy settings for a given URL by executing PAC scripts and processing CFNetwork responses.
